question.zh: 恒生科技在 2026-12-03 或之后首个交易日收盘，会高于 2026-11-03 吗？
question.en: Will Hang Seng Tech close higher on the first trading day on or after 2026-12-03 than on 2026-11-03?

rationale.zh: 近 20 个交易日波动 1.83%/日，平均涨跌 -0.40%/日（按一半计入），周期约 21 个交易日（一个月）。
rationale.en: 20-day volatility 1.83%/day; average move -0.40%/day, counted at half weight; about 21 trading days (one month).
